::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Mark presents Jesus as the suffering Servant and powerful Son of God. The book emphasizes action, authority, and sacrificial service as the path to true greatness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Mark 1:17
Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men
### Why This Verse Famous discipleship call ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces John the Baptist, Jesus' baptism, temptation, and early ministry. The key verse presents Jesus proclaiming the arrival of God's kingdom and calling for repentance and faith. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Mark 2:17
I came not to call the righteous, but sinners
### Why This Verse Mission of Jesus ### Chapter Insight This chapter records healings and growing opposition from religious leaders. The key verse emphasizes Jesus' authority to forgive sins. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Mark 3:35
Whoever does the will of God
### Why This Verse True family of God ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the appointment of the twelve disciples and increasing conflict. The key verse highlights Jesus' establishment of a community centered on doing God's will. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Mark 4:39
Peace, be still
### Why This Verse One of Jesus' best-known miracles ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains parables about the kingdom of God. The key verse teaches that spiritual fruitfulness depends on receiving God's Word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Mark 5:36
Be not afraid, only believe
### Why This Verse Famous encouragement ### Chapter Insight This chapter records dramatic demonstrations of Jesus' power. The key verse reveals Christ's authority over demons, disease, and death. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Mark 6:34
He was moved with compassion
### Why This Verse Character of Jesus ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts rejection at Nazareth, the mission of the twelve, and the feeding of the five thousand. The key verse emphasizes compassion and ministry despite opposition. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Mark 7:6
This people honors Me with their lips
### Why This Verse True worship ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts tradition with true righteousness. The key verse teaches that defilement comes from the heart rather than external practices. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Mark 8:36
What shall it profit a man?
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted sayings of Jesus ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Peter's confession and Jesus' teaching about discipleship. The key verse identifies Jesus as the Messiah and calls followers to self-denial. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Mark 9:23
All things are possible to him that believeth
### Why This Verse Widely quoted faith verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter includes the Transfiguration and further teaching on discipleship. The key verse reveals Jesus' divine glory and the necessity of humble service. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Mark 10:27
With God all things are possible
### Why This Verse Parallel to Matthew 19 ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses marriage, wealth, leadership, and sacrifice. The key verse declares that Jesus came to serve and give His life as a ransom for many. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Mark 11:24
What things soever ye desire when ye pray
### Why This Verse Famous prayer verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the triumphal entry and cleansing of the Temple. The key verse highlights faith, prayer, and God's authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Mark 12:30
Love the Lord thy God with all thy heart
### Why This Verse Greatest Commandment ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains parables and debates with religious leaders. The key verse summarizes true devotion through love for God and neighbor. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Mark 13:31
Heaven and earth shall pass away
### Why This Verse Enduring words of Christ ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents Jesus' teaching about future events. The key verse emphasizes watchfulness and readiness for His return. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Mark 14:38
Watch ye and pray
### Why This Verse Gethsemane instruction ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the Last Supper, Gethsemane, and Jesus' arrest. The key verse highlights the New Covenant established through Christ's sacrifice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Mark 15:34
My God, My God, why hast Thou forsaken Me?
### Why This Verse Crucifixion cry ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Jesus' trial, crucifixion, and burial. The key verse emphasizes Christ's sacrificial death and the centurion's recognition of His identity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Mark 16:15
Go ye into all the world
### Why This Verse Great Commission in Mark ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the resurrection and the commission to proclaim the gospel. The key verse celebrates Christ's victory over death and the spread of the good news. :::
